name: Ansonic
summary: Warrnambool ISP: ansonic.com.au ran the 'Westvic Internet' service (Warrnambool/Camperdown/Portland) from 1997; carried Datafast Telecommunications content by 2000; domain held by ANSONIC ELECTRONICS PTY. LTD. (ACN 094 488 963, later Warrnambool Business Machines).

events.details: Earliest ansonic.com.au capture 29 Mar 1997, branded 'Westvic Internet' - 'Western Victoria's Premier Internet Provider', local-call access from Warrnambool, Camperdown & Portland.

ansonic.com.au carried Datafast Telecommunications Ltd content by early 2000 (Westvic Internet Pty Ltd held ~2.19% of Datafast per its 14 Jul 2000 share register); Datafast-branded pages continued through 2006, then the domain 302-redirected from 2007.
Retail ISP presence on ansonic.com.au ended when captures switched to 302 redirects (2007 onward); the earlier Westvic service had already been absorbed into Datafast Telecommunications.
